summary: CucinaSmart AI iteration 4: all 4 NEW features (Scala Porzioni, Avvisi Scadenze, Foto Ricette, Spesa da Piano) validated end-to-end. Backend: 10/10 pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_iter4_features.py: (a) GET /api/pantry/expiring returns only items with days_left <= days sorted ascending, excludes items with no expires_at, default days=3, verified with offsets [-2,0,2,3,10,30]; (b) POST /api/upload-base64 with data:image/png prefix returns {path,url,token}, GET /api/files/<path>?token= without auth returns exact original bytes 200 with image/* content-type, invalid base64 -> 400, no token & no bearer -> 401; (c) POST /api/meals/to-shopping merges 'Uova 2 pz' + 'Uova 4 pz' across 2 recipe-linked meals -> qty 6 pz aisle 'Latticini' note 'Piano settimanale', pantry items skipped to in_pantry, second call moves all to already_listed, empty range returns {meals:0,recipes:0,added/in_pantry/already_listed:[]}, meals without recipe_id are ignored. Frontend (mobile 390x844, chef@cucina.ai): Oggi KPI (kpi-expiring) shows '2 da usare entro 3 giorni' with item names including 'TEST_Pomodori_urgent (scaduto)'. Recipe detail servings stepper: base '2 porzioni' + Farina 100 g + Sale q.b. -> after 2x serv-plus shows '4 porzioni' with Farina '200 g' and Sale still 'q.b.'; serv-reset returns to '2 porzioni' and '100 g'. recipe-photo button present. Settings ReminderCard renders on web with title 'Promemoria scadenze' and subtitle "Disponibile sull'app per telefono", and the Switch has JSX prop disabled={isWeb} (see note in minor issues). add-recipe screen exposes rec-photo testID. /calendar 'Crea lista della spesa' (week-to-shopping) is visible (because iter3 left saved plan meals in range), clicking it returns week-shop-result with counts and note 'Piano settimanale' — verified server-side; UI showed 'Nulla da aggiungere · 3 già in dispensa · 42 già in lista' because iter3 already populated the shopping list; server-side test independently confirmed added-items path. /weekly-plan renders generate-plan; plan-to-shopping already validated in iter3 flow. Only console messages: expected shadow*/pointerEvents deprecation warnings and expo-notifications web warning. No red screens, no 5xx, no unhandled errors.

ui_bugs.issue: Switch has JSX prop disabled={isWeb} in code (correct), but on react-native-web the disabled attribute is not surfaced on the outer testID container in DOM, so a direct playwright attribute check on [data-testid=reminder-switch] returns null. Functionally the switch does NOT toggle on web (verified by presence of the 'Disponibile sull'app per telefono' subtitle and by code path in ReminderCard.tsx:71). No user-visible bug — only a testability note.

action_items: OPTIONAL LOW (test-only): If you want playwright to be able to assert the web disabled state of the reminder Switch, add aria-disabled={isWeb} or accessibilityState={{disabled: isWeb}} on the Switch (or wrap it in a Pressable with testID and aria-disabled). Purely testability improvement — feature works as intended.

OPTIONAL: The Oggi KPI displays duplicated item names when the pantry has two items with the same name (e.g. 'TEST_Pomodori_urgent · TEST_Pomodori_urgent'). Consider deduping by name in oggi.tsx when building the KPI subtitle (still functional, but slightly odd UX). Reference: kpi-expiring text observed in run 2.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now 988 lines — split into routers (auth, recipes, pantry, shopping, meals, ai, storage, household) remains recommended.
/api/pantry/expiring correctly parses `expires_at[:10]` as ISO date so items stored as 'YYYY-MM-DD' or full ISO datetimes both work; date parsing errors are silently skipped which is safe.

/api/upload-base64 auto-extracts ext from data:image/<ext> prefix; enforces 8MB cap; and normalizes 'jpg'->'jpeg' for content-type. File token TTL is 3650 days (long-lived) which is fine for private user files but consider a shorter default if these URLs are ever shared publicly.

/api/meals/to-shopping merges qty only when unit matches AND unit != 'q.b.' (server.py:599) — correct behavior verified. Uses `_norm_name` for merge keys, `name_matches` for pantry/shopping dedup with singular/plural tolerance.

media.ts pickImage returns a data URI (`data:${mime};base64,${a.base64}`) and uploadImage forwards it as-is; server strips the prefix. On web `chooseImageSource` directly calls onPick('library') → expo-image-picker uses a hidden <input type=file> — flow is compatible with playwright set_input_files but is not a testID-anchored element (that's why the request suggests best-effort testing).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (9/9 flows verified — reminder-switch disabled attribute check is a test-tooling limitation, not a bug)

seed_data_creation: Chef account: created 1 pantry item 'TEST_Pomodori_urgent' (fridge, expired 2 days ago) and 1 recipe 'TEST Servings Recipe' (rec_92efb777461d) with servings=2. Backend tests each create their own isolated TEST_ users via /api/auth/signup and are self-contained (no shared state). Chef pantry also still has iter3 residual 'pomodori/pasta/uova' items and iter3 saved weekly plans (~42 shopping items) — expected, and it's what allowed calendar week-to-shopping to render in this run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iter4 regression suite: /app/backend/tests/test_iter4_features.py runs in ~5s alongside test_new_features.py and test_cucinasmart_api.py (all independent). Key testIDs used: kpi-expiring (oggi), serv-minus/serv-plus/serv-value/serv-reset/ing-qty-{i}/recipe-photo (recipe/[id]), reminder-card/reminder-switch/hour-plus/hour-minus/minute-toggle/preset-<h>-<m>/reminder-open-settings (Settings), rec-photo (add-recipe), week-to-shopping/week-shop-result (calendar), plan-to-shopping/plan-shop-result (weekly-plan). Auth token storage key in the web app is `cucinasmart_token` in localStorage (raw 64-char hex). To seed data programmatically inside playwright, read that key and use fetch(). Chef's calendar contains meals for the coming week (from iter3), so week-to-shopping bar is visible without pre-generating a plan; if you seed a new chef, run /weekly-plan Genera+Salva first to make the bar visible.
rca_of_issue: No blocking bugs. Two low-severity observations only: (1) reminder-switch element on web does not expose disabled/aria-disabled attributes on the testID container, which prevents a direct attribute assertion but does NOT affect behavior — code correctly passes disabled={isWeb} to <Switch>. (2) Oggi KPI can list duplicate item names verbatim when the pantry has duplicates; consider deduplicating names in the KPI subtitle. Neither affects feature correctness.
